c.title: $3,550 / 3br - Kits Furnished Large 3 Bedrooms-Gr Fl-September-Great Location (Kitsilano, Vancouver-UBC/Beach)
c.description:
The property at one of the most desirable living places in Kitsilano, lots of fun things to do year-round.
The entire suite just been painted and ready for move in.
It is a nice place, with easy short transit to UBC, downtown or anywhere.

The three bedrooms, living room, kitchen and bathroom, partly furnished.

Five minutes walk to the beach. Major bus lines to UBC and downtown are all within a few steps - including the 84, 44 Express buses, and minutes to the 99 B-line.
New developments are popping up to keep this location to be one of the most desirable places to live, of enjoyment and fun things to do.

Public parks, tennis court and the beach are just minutes of walking distance.
Relax and have fun on the beach, walk on the ocean floor afar when low tide, watch the waves on the ocean and the sunset. watch the firework in the summer.
Jog in the neighbourhood, play tennis at the tennis court (2 blocks away).

Rent $3550 + per month.
Minimum one year Lease required.

Two supermarket grocery stores, Fresh Street and Safeway, food stores and cafes of all kinds, Naam restaurant and many other shops are all close-by, also Darby liquor store just around at West 4th Ave.

There are three large bedrooms on the ground floor, each bedroom is fitted with full or single size bed with lots of room around. Each of the bedrooms is furnished with a dresser.
In addition, there is a walk in closet of about 8 foot wide in each bedroom.

One of the three bedrooms is extra large with two windows.

Living room is furnished with a very comfortable couch and chair, coffee table, shelves and table and chairs in the dining area, etc.

Living room and kitchen are combined in one open area.
There are windows throughout the bedrooms, living room, kitchen and bathroom.

Kitchen area with dishwasher, cabinet and countertop.
Bathroom with tub and shower.

Washer and dryer provided for laundry.
